title: Manual
description: The frontmatter of a manual: the pilot's settled understanding of one topic, stated in its current form only, so one file answers one question. Filed by name, agent-teams.md. It carries no identifier: a manual is looked up by its topic, not referred to by number. What the old one-line header carried — Source, Validated, Stub — are these keys, so the body holds no citation. Every manual carries either a source or stub: true, never both.
x-expect: either a source saying where the claims come from, or stub: true for a manual that is existing knowledge only

type.description: the word Manual, which is what chooses this schema

source.description: where the manual's claims come from: a url, a branch and path at a commit, or the seat and date that researched it. Absent only on a stub

stub.description: true when the manual is existing knowledge only, not validated and not to be cited as authority; a stub has no source by definition, which is the point of the form

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

style.description: record for a topic stated whole, register for one domain of adjudicated findings one line at a time; record when omitted

validated.description: who checked the manual against its sources and when, never applied by its own writer; omitted until someone has

context.description: the identifiers this manual was extracted from, a bracketed list
